whyItMatters: mark_safe writes unescaped markup in python, so untrusted input reaching it becomes cross-site scripting.
actions: Escape the value with conditional_escape or template autoescape or bind it as text content.
If raw markup is required, sanitize it against an allowlist of tags and attributes.
Re-run the scan and confirm no mark_safe call remains reachable from untrusted input.
verification: Rescan shows no mark_safe reachable from untrusted input, and markup probes render inert.
